home.practice_pact_blurb: Spades with a partner across the table. Bid the tricks you'll take, then take them, and no more. Four hands.
pact.title: Pact
pact.how_to: You and your partner sit across from two rivals. Each hand you bid the tricks you mean to take, or nil for none. Then everyone plays a card in turn, following the suit led if they can; the highest card of that suit takes the trick, unless a spade is played, and the highest spade takes it. Make your side's pact for ten points a trick bid.
pact.how_to_keyboard: Left and right pick a card or a bid, and space or enter plays it. Number keys pick a bid: 0 is nil, and 1, 2, 3 then 0 to 3 make ten to thirteen.
pact.sitting_note: A sitting is {hands} hands. A hand never scores below zero for your side: miss your pact and you score nothing for it.
pact.seats_note: Your partner and both rivals play the same way, and see only their own cards and what has been played.
pact.hint_note: Practice rounds suggest a bid or a card when you pause.
pact.bid_prompt: Your bid: how many tricks will you take?
pact.legend_spade: Spades: a leaf on a stem. Trumps: any spade beats every other suit.
pact.legend_club: Clubs: three leaves on a stem.
pact.legend_partner: Your partner sits across from you. Your bids add up to your side's pact.
pact.legend_scoring: Make the pact: 10 a trick bid, 1 a trick over (a bag). Fall short: nothing. Nil made: 100. Nil broken: minus 100 inside the hand. Ten bags cost 100. Setting the rivals pays 10 a trick they bid.
studio.preset.pact_plain: Plain count: no set bonus, no bag penalty, no nil
